limits: No operator database, HOME, hardware, attestation, real network/mail or Git mutation was used. SQLite and lock files belong to temporary fixtures.
Auxiliary queue admission and bounty enqueue are not durability acknowledgements. Failed transaction retention is in RAM; ambiguous COMMIT requires inspection before retry, not assumed rollback.

Kernel tracking is admission only. Stop drains; forced cancellation propagates but does not provide durable job recovery or per-claim acknowledgement. Caller must observe the loop and reconcile tracking IDs.
Tests exercise cooperative local SQLite/async tasks, not physical power failure, hostile writers or cross-event-loop/thread sharing.
DAG cleanup can retain the lock indefinitely for cancellation-resistant tasks; no forced termination or redesign of the inherited lock identity policy is claimed.
Node VM executes real Worker control flow with injected MIME/platform boundaries. It demonstrates rejection/resolution, not SMTP redelivery, deployment or platform retry guarantees.

SW100-C0434.rationale: An ordered sentinel drains all accepted auxiliary transactions before normal shutdown. Batch and writer failures are observable and retain uncommitted work in RAM; a shielded owned initialization task cannot reopen admission after concurrent close or caller cancellation. Independent real-SQLite admission, rollback and lifecycle controls pass; durable job recovery and ambiguous-COMMIT resolution are not claimed.

source_checks.observation: Initialization is owned and shielded; cancellation starts shared closure rather than abandoning a connection being opened.
Ordered batches commit before the stop sentinel; failed batch/backlog is accounted for and retained, not silently discarded.
Closure waits for initialization and writer completion, raises for writer failure and closes the connection.
Admission rejects stopped or failed queues and enqueues without yielding between validation and insertion.

SW100-C0358.rationale: Each of the three domain branches checks enqueue acceptance and propagates rejection or writer exceptions before returning a success report. Positive reports identify QUEUED_NOT_CONFIRMED rather than claiming durability. Independent rejection at each partial-cycle position and a successful three-domain cycle pass with inert consumers; no atomic cross-domain transaction is claimed.

SW100-C0208.rationale: The current committed tip and logical tick are selected within BEGIN IMMEDIATE before hashing and inserting. A missing tracking ID is not accepted as replay, and cancellation of an active state-loop is propagated rather than returning normal completion. Four concurrent instances preserve 120 admitted IDs and every independently recomputed chain link. Admission is not a per-claim durability acknowledgement or durable cancellation recovery.

SW100-C0509.rationale: The scheduler owns and shields all task completion. On failure or caller cancellation it cancels and awaits every sibling under ThermalLock, resisting repeated caller cancellation during cleanup. An actual competing scheduler remains excluded until cleanup completes in independent fixtures. A cancellation-resistant sibling can retain exclusion indefinitely; forced termination is not claimed.

source_checks.observation: Failure cleanup cancels and awaits every owned task while still inside ThermalLock; repeated caller cancellation cannot interrupt the drain and release exclusion early.

SW100-C0422.rationale: After three exhausted HTTP or transport failures the Worker throws instead of resolving the email handler. Valid 2xx success resolves without unnecessary attempts. Independent Node fixtures execute real Worker control flow with injected MIME/platform boundaries; SMTP redelivery, deployment and platform retry guarantees remain unverified.
